items.title: DH Business Rwanda Ltd expands supply categories
items.body: We've broadened our tender supply capacity to cover eight categories, including biological assets and medical & veterinary supplies, alongside our existing food, stationery, construction and furniture lines.

items.title: Now accepting direct quotation requests
items.body: In addition to formal tender submissions, procuring entities and private organisations can now request quotations directly through our contact page for faster turnaround.

items.title: Nationwide delivery coordination in place
items.body: Our logistics coordination now covers delivery to sites outside Kigali, supporting institutions procuring goods for facilities across Rwanda.
